events.name: GXY SUMMITS & SWITCHBACKS
events.summary: SUMMITS AND SWITCHBACKS is a weekly social spin that targets the more undulating courses on Zwift and staying in the draft is essential on these type of courses for this event
events.description:
SUMMITS AND SWITCHBACKS is a weekly social spin that targets the more undulating courses on Zwift and staying in the draft is essential on these type of courses for this event 

EVENT DYNAMICS

Category	- C
Power 	- 2.3 > 3.0wkg but expect the event to finish around 2.65wkg based on a 75kg rider.
Fence 	- Will be set to KICK! used at the leader's discretion
Draft	- Enabled – focus required to stay within the group
Sweeper     - Yes! Red beacon and beacon support riders will have a GXY tag after their name

ETHOS 

We at GXY are committed to creating a culture of belonging, inclusivity and compassion empowering people to grow stronger, work together and support one another to achieve shared success on Zwift

GXY – Here together, for you 💜

If you want to become a member and join our community to race, ride socially, or both, please come and join ideally via our Facebook link:

https://www.facebook.com/groups/galaxycyclingclub/
https://www.strava.com/clubs/989894
https://www.instagram.com/galaxycyclingclub
